description: This file defines the custom exception class 'AccountingRuleNotFoundException' used in the accounting rule module of the project, extending a platform exception class and including constructors for different error scenarios.

classes.name: AccountingRuleNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that an accounting rule with a specific ID was not found.

methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message indicating the specific ID that was not found.
